name: Chirusato Kemari
source:
A girl who attends a cram school.

She lacks self-confidence and wishes she could be stronger.

For some reason, she feels a sense of kinship with Shichirouta.

[from [url=https://winters.world.coocan.jp/newpage153.html]official site[/url]]
